question: Should QQBot support `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` as a real data-directory override, or should the diagnostic stop recommending that env var?
rationale: Current main tells Windows users to set the env var, but current tests and recent storage work treat the QQBot data helper as a compatibility/legacy path, so automation should not choose the config contract for maintainers.

options.title: Support a validated override
options.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, intentionally supported `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require real diagnostic proof before merge.

options.title: Retire the env hint
options.body: Remove or replace the `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` diagnostic guidance and close or redirect the linked implementation PR as not planned for this storage path.

recommendation.title: Support a validated override
recommendation.body: Honor a trimmed, normalized, intentionally supported `QQBOT_DATA_DIR` in the QQBot data helper, update docs/tests, and require real diagnostic proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QQBot SQLite storage migration work makes this the best available owner for the data-root contract decision.
